versions.changelog:
- Initial release of stack-push skill, ported from claude-night-market/sanctum.
- Automates pushing all branches in a stack and opening or updating one dependent PR per slice, each targeting its parent branch.
- Guides users through branch listing, pushing, PR creation/update, and posting a stack summary.
- Supports both git and jj CLI workflows.
- Integrates with additional skills for stack creation and PR preparation.
- Requires progress tracked via TodoWrite items for workflow visibility.
